name: wire-experience-hints-into-review-loop
title: Surface the A/B-gated Experience Layer hints in the REVIEW reviewer-launch guidance (+ shared firing leaf) so the ON arm reaches lane reviewers and experience_hint_surfaced accrues
description: Today experience hints render only in story_review _reviewPrompt (PLAN), but REVIEW lane reviewers are launched with hand-written prompts that bypass it, so the ON arm never influences review and REVIEW rounds emit zero experience_hint_surfaced. Extract a single shared leaf core/experience-hint-surface.ts (surfaceExperienceHints: firing+dedup+arm), refactor story-review.ts to use it (byte-preserving), and surface the rendered+gated hints in buildNextSteps REVIEW branch (transition-effects.ts) so they appear in the reviewer-launch text the agent reads and fire the A/B event (PLAN plan:<phase> vs REVIEW ISO-round key = disjoint, no double-count). Advisory-only: review-run.ts/resolveReviewPromptHash untouched + byte-identical arms; OFF appends nothing; no new command. + smoke.
